analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md, with a single hunk at head lines 2966-2970. It adds documentation that the cluster service re-plans after an update only once both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), and links to the pair's coordinated update section. The supplied units (head lines 4069-4926) are unchanged surrounding text and fall outside the changed range. That text covers GLM chunk bounds, authenticated records, cluster KV precision, SSD prefix record encoding, GPT-OSS/MiMo/Gemma batch paths and manifest pins. I examined it against T-041 (prefix cache and SSD at-rest), TB-007, TB-003 and the A-001 and A-004 assets.

No security behavior changes. This is a documentation-only edit with no code, config, key handling, authorization, attestation or encryption changes.

The documentation describes a fail-closed load agreement for mismatched ranks and for KV and prefix-record precision, and states that the cluster SSD prefix records are encrypted and sealed with header encoding. These are consistent with T-041 and do not weaken its posture. The text states explicitly that the encoded-precision restore is lossy by contract and that qualification gates remain.

Open question for integration: the new text is only a documentation claim. It refers to the ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild gate and the coordinated-update doc, and the code was not supplied, so I could not verify that they exist or behave as described. The gate has an availability/consistency effect (a re-plan that waits when builds differ). I identified no concrete regression and raise no finding.
